description: You are a digital media librarian managing the Chinook music store catalog in LibreOffice Base. The database contains 3503 tracks across 275 artists, 347 albums, 25 genres, and 5 media types. Your task: (1) Create a saved SQL query named 'FullTrackCatalog' that performs a 5-table join across Track, Album, Artist, Genre, and MediaType tables — it must produce at minimum: TrackId, track Name (as TrackName), album Title (as AlbumTitle), artist Name (as ArtistName), genre Name (as GenreName), media type Name (as MediaTypeName), Milliseconds, and UnitPrice; (2) Create a saved SQL query named 'GenreMediaBreakdown' that joins Genre, Track, and MediaType tables, groups by genre AND media type, and computes TrackCount and total revenue (SUM of UnitPrice); (3) Create a table named 'TrackReview' with at least columns: ReviewId (integer, primary key), TrackId (integer), Rating (integer), ReviewText (long text), ReviewDate (date); (4) Insert at least 5 review rows into TrackReview using real Chinook track IDs (valid range: 1-3503) and ratings between 1 and 5 — use diverse track IDs; (5) Create a report named 'Media Catalog' or 'Track Catalog' (name must contain 'Catalog' or 'Media') presenting the catalog data. All objects must be saved in chinook.odb.
